biography:
Growth-oriented manager with 15+ years of experience in origination and development. Delivered $0.5 billion in new business opportunities for the real estate industry in Brazil, closed the acquisition of 46MWdc in new DG projects in the US after only eight months in the industry, and is responsible for managing the development of over $600 million CAPEX in utility-scale solar and battery storage projects in the Western states of the US. End to end negotiator who has skills and knowledge to identify, develop, execute, and exit successful transactions.
